# Task Completion Summary

Based on the worker report, the task has been **successfully completed**:

## What Was Done

The worker identified and consolidated the duplicate CRM tickets properly:

- **Consolidated 3 duplicate reports** (T-1052, T-1053, T-1054) all reporting the same underlying problem: CRM search returning 500 errors
- **Merged T-1053 and T-1054 into T-1052** (the earliest-created report, per policy)
- **Left genuinely different issues untouched**: T-1055 (CSV export problem) and T-1061 (engineering tracking ticket) were correctly identified as separate and left alone

## Correct Grading and Assignment

- **Severity set to sev2** based on department-level impact from the escalation matrix
- **Assigned to E-201 Ines Kovac**, the engineer on call for the business-apps rotation when the deadline falls
- **SLA deadline set to 2026-03-17T12:40:00Z**, the earliest deadline from any of the merged tickets (honoring the policy that committed deadlines are never moved earlier)

## Result

The Revenue Ops team now has a single consolidated ticket (T-1052) for the CRM search problem, properly graded, assigned, and with the correct deadline. The duplicate reports have been eliminated, and distinct issues have been preserved as separate tickets.

The work follows the domain policy requirements in full.
